claim: "repairs with a supplement averaged 13.2 days versus 8.8 days for those without" (problem.summary) and "13.2 days versus 8.8 days for those without (2020 comparison)" (measured_outcomes[0])
problem: Misread number. In the CCC data as reported by Auto Insurance Report (July 28, 2025), 13.2 days is the 2024 average for repairs WITH a supplement and 7.7 days is the 2024 average for repairs WITHOUT one (the gap is the stated +5.5 days). 8.8 days is the 2020 average for repairs WITH a supplement (2020 without-supplement was 5.4). The brief presents 8.8 as the no-supplement figure, which the source does not say for either year.
fix: Rewrite as: repairs with a supplement averaged 13.2 days in 2024 versus 7.7 days without (a 5.5-day gap), and the with-supplement average was 8.8 days in 2020. Drop "8.8 days for those without" everywhere.
